question: Who launched Prismix, an AI-driven media company?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ajay Devgn**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Ajay Devgn**, a renowned Bollywood actor, producer, and director, launched **Prismix**, an AI-driven media company.
 
• Prismix focuses on leveraging artificial intelligence to create innovative solutions for the media and entertainment industry.
 
• The company aims to explore technological advancements such as AI and machine learning to enhance storytelling and digital content creation.
 
• Ajay Devgn has been actively involved in expanding his ventures beyond acting, including film production and digital platforms, showcasing his entrepreneurial skills.
 
• Prismix reflects Devgn's vision for the future of media, combining creativity with cutting-edge technology to revolutionize content consumption.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Salman Khan:**

• **Aamir Khan:**
 
 
• Aamir Khan is an acclaimed actor and filmmaker, often referred to as the "Perfectionist" of Bollywood.
 
• He spearheaded the social awareness talk show **Satyamev Jayate**, addressing critical societal issues.
 
• Aamir has been actively advocating for various causes, including education and water conservation.
 
 
 
• **Shahrukh Khan:**
 
 
• Shahrukh Khan, popularly known as the "King of Bollywood," is a versatile actor and producer.
 
• He is the co-owner of the IPL team **Kolkata Knight Riders** and has ventured into film production with **Red Chillies Entertainment**.
 
• Shahrukh has received numerous accolades, including international recognition, for his contributions to cinema.
